### Summary

The VIC solves each $x_1$ column implicitly for the stage's changes of mass, normal momentum and energy. Its
assembly, column closure, sweep, rejection, constituent redistribution and stage weighting are in the
time-integration chapter (@sec-ch09-vic-assembly, @sec-ch09-vic-closure, @sec-ch09-vic-sweep, @sec-ch09-vic-reject,
@sec-ch09-vic-redistribute, @sec-ch09-vic-stage, @sec-ch09-vic-options). This section states only where gravity
enters it. The momentum row's mass column and the energy row's momentum column hold the gravity source Jacobian
$\Phi$[^rg-1f2c44c9087e], the linearisation of the body force $\rho g_1$ and of the cell work $\rho v_1g_1$. The energy row is then
changed so that it books the face form of the mass the solve itself moves, @eq-ch06-vic-rows; at the pin this is
always done, with no switch. With the corrected-PE work on, the energy row also carries that work's operator
(@sec-ch06-dwork). After the solve two corrections book the work of the mass that the projection and the
availability clamp moved differently from what the matrix assumed, so the booked energy matches the mass moved.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Puts the face gravity work into the vertical implicit correction (VIC), @eq-ch06-vic-rows, so the solve books it.

**Data.** The gravity entries of the energy row (and, through $\Phi$, the momentum row) of each block row.

**Placement.** Once per stage per column, when the VIC rows are assembled; the work corrections after the solve.

**Activation.** `implicit-scheme` 1 or 9 with `const-gravity`; the rows add zeros when $g_1=0$.

**Guarantee / limits.** A linearisation about the stage state; the post-solve corrections match the mass actually moved.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch06-vic-tests.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathbf e_{m_1}$ the unit row vector of the normal-momentum unknown; $[\mathsf X]_\rho$ and
$[\mathsf X]_E$ the mass and energy rows of a block $\mathsf X$; $m_{1,i}=\mathbf e_{m_1}\mathbf q_i$. $\mathsf A_i$[^rg-47f774f5b4d6],
$\mathsf B_i$, $\mathsf C_i$, $\mathsf A^\pm$, $\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i$[^rg-26618cb146eb], $\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i$ and $\boldsymbol\delta_i$ are
defined in @sec-appa. $N$ is the buoyancy (Brunt–Väisälä) frequency of the column [s$^{-1}$].

### Derivation

**The operator this section adds to.** The unknown of block row $i$ is $\mathbf q_i = (\rho, \rho v_1, E)_i$ with
`implicit-scheme` 1 and $(\rho, \rho v_1, \rho v_2, \rho v_3, E)_i$ with 9, $\rho$ the total density; each column is
one block-tridiagonal system
$\mathsf B_i\boldsymbol\delta_{i-1} + \mathsf A_i\boldsymbol\delta_i + \mathsf C_i\boldsymbol\delta_{i+1} = \mathbf r_i$,
whose flux part is the Roe linearisation of @sec-ch09-vic-assembly with the frozen dissipation matrices
$\mathsf A^\pm$. This section adds only gravity entries.

The face form @eq-ch06-dwork-face can be written with the weights
$\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i = \tfrac12A_{i-1/2}(x_{1,i}-x_{1,i-1/2})/V_i$ and
$\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i = \tfrac12A_{i+1/2}(x_{1,i+1/2}-x_{1,i})/V_i$ as
$W^{\mathrm{face}}_i = 2g_1(\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_iF_{i+1/2}+\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_iF_{i-1/2})$. The solve's own mass
flux, linearised, is $F_{i+1/2} = \tfrac12(m_{1,i}+m_{1,i+1}) - \tfrac12[\mathsf A^+]_\rho(\mathbf q_{i+1}-\mathbf q_i)$.
Substituting, and moving the work to the left-hand side, the gravity entries of the energy row of block row $i$ are

$$
\begin{aligned}
[\mathsf B_i]_E &= -g_1\,\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i\big(\mathbf e_{m_1} + [\mathsf A^-]_\rho\big),\\
[\mathsf A_i]_E &= -g_1\big(\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i+\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i\big)\mathbf e_{m_1}
  - g_1\big(\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i[\mathsf A^+]_\rho - \omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i[\mathsf A^-]_\rho\big),\\
[\mathsf C_i]_E &= -g_1\,\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i\big(\mathbf e_{m_1} - [\mathsf A^+]_\rho\big).
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch06-vic-rows}

In the code, `vic_assemble_impl` sets `Phi(IPR, IVX + dir) = grav` and subtracts `Phi` from `a[i]`
({{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_impl.h vic_assemble_impl >}}), and `vic_gravity_work_rows`
({{< code src/implicit/vic_gravity_work_impl.h vic_gravity_work_rows >}}) adds the rest, so the momentum entry of
$[\mathsf A_i]_E$ is $-g_1+g_1(1-\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i-\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i)=-g_1(\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i+\omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i)$, as
in @eq-ch06-vic-rows. One function writes these rows for both matrices, partial ($3\times3$) and full ($5\times5$). The
weights are `GravityWork::face_lo` and `face_hi`, built once per grid, device, dtype and gravity by
`GravityWork::update` ({{< code src/hydro/gravity_work.hpp GravityWork::update >}}); on a uniform Cartesian grid both
are $\tfrac14$. `vicwork_check.py` `[C1]` ports the rows and finds them equal to minus the linearised face work to
$7\times10^{-15}$ over 200 random rows, and `[C2]` finds the Cartesian weights $\tfrac14$.[^ch06-vic-chk]

After the solve, `book_remainder_` ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitHydroImpl::book_remainder_ >}})
books, always, $\phi_i$[^rg-6f8cf364cedd] times the difference between the raw solved mass change, the explicit change and the mass the
projection moved (`projection_work`), and the potential-energy flux of the mass the availability clamp moved minus
what was requested (`clamp_work`). The first vanishes when the solve is applied as solved; the second keeps
$E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ over a closed column (`[C4]`). With the corrected-PE work on, the same function adds
that work's remainder, @eq-ch06-dwork-remainder.

[^ch06-vic-chk]: [sha: snapy@6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5, ported line for line: the energy rows of
    `vic_assemble_full_impl`, `work_lo`/`work_hi` and the projection and clamp work; deck: the check itself; run:
    `python3 src/snapy_report/ch06/checks/vicwork_check.py`, CPU, double, 1 process; Python 3.11.13, numpy 2.4.6; output
    identical to the committed file]. Output `vicwork_check.out`, lines `[C1]`, `[C2]` and `[C4]`. The rows it ports
    are those of `vic_gravity_work_rows` at 73c45a7c, written once for both matrices; the check was not re-run at
    73c45a7c.

### Numerical method

@fig-ch06-vic-rows shows the energy-row entries. The rows are assembled once per stage per column at the stage state,
so they are a linearisation; the step taken is $\Delta t_c$. Before the solve the explicit face correction is added
to the right-hand side, so the energy the solve inverts is the face-form energy
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). The column closure at the ends is the VIC's own
(@sec-ch09-vic-closure); immersed solids get no projection, clamp or corrected-PE work.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch06-vic-rows
#| fig-cap: "Gravity entries of the energy row of block row i of the VIC: in the blocks of cell i-1 (B), cell i (A) and cell i+1 (C), m is the normal-momentum column and A-, A+ the mass rows of the Roe dissipation matrices at faces i-1/2 and i+1/2; lo and hi are the face-work weights. The momentum entries are the face-weighted average of the three cells."
#| fig-alt: "One row of three boxes with formulas, under the headers b[i], a[i] and c[i]."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch06.figures.fig_vic_rows import make_fig
make_fig()
```

### Code

**A minimal input.**

<!-- reader glossary keys -->Keys in this fragment: `integration`[^rg-ccef979766bf].
```yaml
integration:
  implicit-scheme: 9       # 1 = vic-partial, 9 = vic-full
forcing:
  const-gravity:
    grav1: -9.8            # the face work is in the operator
```

**What the code refuses, and why.** An `implicit-scheme` other than 0, 1 or 9 ("Unsupported implicit scheme"):
there are only two solvers. An $x_1$ split under an implicit scheme ("[Hydro] implicit scheme requires nb1 = 1"):
the column solve has no coupling between blocks (@sec-ch03-x1seams).

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| gravity source Jacobian | {{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_impl.h vic_assemble_impl >}} | `Phi` | `const-gravity` |
| energy-row face work | {{< code src/implicit/vic_gravity_work_impl.h vic_gravity_work_rows >}} | `vic_gravity_work_rows` | `implicit-scheme` |
| face weights | {{< code src/hydro/gravity_work.hpp GravityWork::update >}} | `_face_lo` | none |
| projection and clamp work | {{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitHydroImpl::book_remainder_ >}} | `projection_work` | none |
| explicit correction before the solve | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `gravity_energy_correction` | `implicit-scheme` |

: Code map of the gravity work in the implicit operator. {#tbl-ch06-vic-code}

1. `GravityWork::update` forms the face weights, areas, volumes and potentials once per grid.
2. `vic_assemble_impl` adds $\Phi$ and calls `vic_gravity_work_rows` for each cell.
3. `HydroImpl::forward` adds the explicit face correction to `du` before `_apply_implicit_correction`.
4. After the solve and the redistribution, `book_remainder_` adds the projection and clamp work, and the corrected-PE
   remainder when that work is on.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The rows are a linearisation about the stage state. Face work booked after the solve, outside the operator, makes a
tall column blow up at large implicit steps; at the pin no deck can select that booking, and the onset table below is
kept because it says why the work must stay in the operator.
:::

| acoustic Courant number | $N\Delta t$ at onset |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2.3 to 2.9 |
| 10 | about 7 |
| 100 | about 20 |

: Onset of the blow-up of a tall column under an implicit scheme when the face work is booked after the solve, from a
linear model of the column.[^ch06-vic-onset] $N\Delta t$ is the time step in units of the buoyancy period over $2\pi$.
{#tbl-ch06-vic-onset}

[^ch06-vic-onset]: [source: linear-model result in the project discussion thread 1794212148.557499, archived there as a
    bundle whose onsets for acoustic Courant 1 to 200 are a CSV, sha256 `3a959ec3…8d7e7a` (abbreviated as recorded in
    the thread). The bundle is not in the repository, and no deck, script, sha or command for it is recorded here, so
    the three rows are **missing evidence** until that CSV and its model are committed with their run record.]

- The VIC closes each column as a reflecting wall whatever the $x_1$ boundary (@sec-ch09-vic-closure).
- Combinations with the study switches: @sec-ch12-matrix.

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-1f2c44c9087e]: $\Phi$ — the gravity source Jacobian; upright, not sans-serif like the other matrices, because the math font has no sans-serif Greek and `\mathsf` drops the glyph in the PDF

[^rg-47f774f5b4d6]: $\mathsf A_i, \mathsf B_i, \mathsf C_i$ — the diagonal, lower and upper blocks of row $i$ of the block-tridiagonal system

[^rg-26618cb146eb]: $\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i, \omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i$ — the implicit face-work weights $\tfrac12A_{i\mp1/2}\lvert x_{1,i}-x_{1,i\mp1/2}\rvert/V_i$

[^rg-6f8cf364cedd]: $\phi_i$, $\phi_{i\pm1/2}$ — $\phi$ at the centroid and at the faces

[^rg-ccef979766bf]: integration — time-integration options
